parameters.name: AgentCertificateId
parameters.description: The ID of the certificate to query. Call the ListAtiCertificates operation to query the information about the target certificate and obtain the ID from the response.

parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

Generate a parameter value from your client to ensure that the value is unique among different requests. ClientToken supports only ASCII characters.

> If you do not specify this parameter, the system uses the **RequestId** of the API request as the **ClientToken**. The **RequestId** of each API request is different.
